messages:
sam.green: FYI — model onboarding snapshot ready. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/onboard/mpt-12b-v2/weights.tar.gz. need quant readiness signoff (AWQ/GPTQ/FP8) and tokenizer sanity checks before we promote to staging.

maya.li: thanks. which calibration set did you use for AWQ? any eval numbers yet?

sam.green: calib used: s3://redwood-models/calib/mpt-12b/v2/calib-2026-03-12/ (10k examples, mix of instr+conv+qa). quick eval below (small prompt set):
- AWQ8: avg acc 87.9% (delta -1.1)
- GPTQ4: avg acc 88.6% (delta -0.4)
- FP8: avg acc 87.0% (delta -2.0)
these are quick pass numbers, need full eval harness run.

chris.ng: @sam.green can you paste the serving config you expect? i want to validate fallback/route logic.

sam.green: sure — current recommended serving.yaml snippet:

```yaml
serving:
  batch_size: 8
  max_tokens: 2048
  kv_cache: true
  quant_policy:
    primary: awq8
    fallback: gptq4
    allow_fp8: false
  routing:
    prefer_region: us-west-2
    fallback_on_error: true
```

rachel.k: quick note on tokenizer: we saw URL-heavy docs get split into >3x tokens with current tokenizer. that blows up cost and can skew calibration.

maya.li: any concrete tokenizer quirk? examples?

rachel.k: e.g. "https://docs.example.com/api/v1/get" tokenizes as 14 tokens. suggestion: set split_on_special_tokens: false or add URL normalization pre-tokenize. small patch below.

chris.ng: +1 on normalization. also we should run a smoke eval comparing logits distributions post-quant — AWQ sometimes shifts logits on rare tokens. i can run those.

toni: i can kick off full eval harness this afternoon. what's the command?

sam.green: use this for now:

```bash
python infra/quant_eval.py \
  --model s3://redwood-models/onboard/mpt-12b-v2/weights.tar.gz \
  --calib s3://redwood-models/calib/mpt-12b/v2/calib-2026-03-12/ \
  --methods awq,gptq,fp8 \
  --out /tmp/mpt12b-quant-eval.json
```

devops-bot: deploy-check: artifact exists, checksum ok (sha256: 3a7c...e9). staging pool has 2x g4dn ready.

infra-bot: disk usage note: model unpack uses ~45GB; need temp disk >=60GB on runner, otherwise job fails with OOM.

toni: started full run (job id: eval-1935-01). will post results to /alerts/quant-reports when done.

maya.li: question for product: is -1.1% across our benchmark acceptable for AWQ8? tradeoff vs 2x cost reduction?

rachel.k: product said tolerances: <=1.5% drop on aggregate but watch regressions on safety and QA prompts. must pass safety eval.

chris.ng: found one prompt where AWQ produced repeated token loop in generation (prob ~0.12). adding that to the exclusion set for calibration and notify QA.

sam.green: thanks. plan: wait for toni's full eval + chris logits check + tokenizer normalization patch. if all green, I'll flip quant_policy.primary to awq8 in staging and enable metric gating (auto-fallback to gptq4 if rouge score delta > threshold).

toni: full eval finished: summary (short):
- AWQ8: aggregate acc 87.7 (-1.3)
- GPTQ4: aggregate acc 88.5 (-0.5)
- FP8: flaky on safety suite, several fails
- safety-suite: AWQ8 PASS overall, 3 borderline prompts flagged
full report: https://internal.redwood/reports/eval/eval-1935-01 (uploaded)

rachel.k: thanks. can you add the flagged prompts to the regression dashboard?

toni: done — /dashboard/regressions/mpt-12b-v2/ has entries.

chris.ng: ran logits drift check: AWQ8 mean KL divergence vs fp32 = 0.007 (ok), but heavy tail tokens show spikes. for now keep fallback gptq4 in routing.

sam.green: consensus: proceed to staging with AWQ8 primary + GPTQ4 fallback, disable FP8 for now. leaving action items:
- chris.ng: PR for tokenizer normalization + unit test (owner: chris)
- toni: add flagged prompts to eval suite and rerun nightly (owner: toni)
- infra-bot: ensure runners have temp disk >=60GB (owner: infra)
- sam.green: flip staging config and monitor metrics for 24h (owner: sam)

maya.li: acked. i'll do a quick code review on chris' PR this afternoon.

chris.ng: ping me for review, will drop link once open.

devops-bot: staging config updated in preview (dry-run). no promotion yet.

sam.green: thanks all. will post a short postmortem if any regressions show up during 24h canary. :thumbsup:

maya.li: :raised_hands:

rachel.k: thanks team — good coverage.
